title: fix(peers): resolve workspace package peer dependencies from root (pnpm/pnpm#14982)
body: When `pnpm peers check` or the install-time peer check walks linked workspace packages, peer dependencies provided by the workspace root were previously reported as missing even when `resolvePeersFromWorkspaceRoot` was enabled. Forward `resolve_peers_from_workspace_root` to lockfile peer inspection and consult the root importer's project dependencies when inspecting linked packages. Fixes pnpm/pnpm#14982 --- Need help on this PR? Tag @codesmith-bot with what you need. Autofix is disabled. ## Summary by CodeRabbit * **Bug Fixes** * Peer dependency checks during installation and with `pnpm peers check` now resolve dependencies from the workspace root when workspace-root resolution is enabled. * Peer dependencies that are missing or incompatible at the workspace root continue to be reported accurately.
